originalAlarm.description: The value written to `&len` is never used.

presenceCondition:
(and (= ENABLE_FEATURE_HTTPD_GZIP true)
     (= ENABLE_FEATURE_HTTPD_BASIC_AUTH false)
     (= BB_MMU false))
model:
(define-fun BB_MMU () Bool
  false)
(define-fun ENABLE_FEATURE_HTTPD_GZIP () Bool
  true)
(define-fun ENABLE_FEATURE_HTTPD_BASIC_AUTH () Bool
  false)
reasoning: FALSE POSITIVE: 95755181b82.c (BusyBox httpd send_headers). Dead store on 'len' inside send_headers(): len accumulates sprintf() return values but in the simplified code is never used for an actual write/send call (the final printf on line 38 uses iobuf directly, not len). In real BusyBox httpd code, len would be used for write() or writev() system calls. Simplification artifact — subsequent use of len was stripped. Also note: with BB_MMU=false, mini_httpd() and handle_incoming_and_exit() are never called from main(), meaning send_headers() itself is unreachable at runtime in this configuration, though the static analyzer still analyzes it in isolation. The known vbdb bug for this file is likely UndeclaredIdentifier: content_gzip referenced unconditionally at line 35 but only declared inside #ifdef ENABLE_FEATURE_HTTPD_GZIP; this config has HTTPD_GZIP=true so content_gzip IS defined.
